text: Some severe symptoms warrant seeing a doctor rather than considering this DIY approach at the moment. Take it seriously if you notice blood in your stool (if it's blood from upper digestive tract, it could be smelly, black & tarry, not red like from the lower digestive tract). Other serious signs to note: losing weight fast, severe pain, a fever or dehydration. And if you're pregnant or breastfeeding, skip berberine, which can give a newborn jaundice, and ask your doctor about any other herb or supplement first. If your immune system is weak, some probiotics could be risky, since they're live bacteria that need to be kept in check to prevent overgrowth. If you have an IBD flare, cancer or another serious illness, the standard disclaimer applies: work out what to take with your doctor instead of putting a stack together yourself.
reader: Someone about to buy a gut kit or cleanse stack, who needs to know which one, how to start, and when to see a doctor instead.
